# kiln 0.3.0

> Public versioned CadQuery projects and immutable build archives, with
> Cloudflare Access-protected authoring and bounded geometry compute.

Production: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/

All stored project data is public on the public hostname. Browser authoring uses
Cloudflare Access SSO. RFC 8707-capable MCP clients use Access Managed OAuth.
KILN_API_KEY remains an optional automation and local-development fallback.

Geometry results are bounded preflight heuristics. They do not certify
printability, support requirements, fit, strength, manufacturing quality,
regulatory compliance, or safety.

## Primary interfaces
- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/mcp
- MCP Registry metadata: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/server.json
- REST guide: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/api.md
- Authentication: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/auth.md
- OpenAPI 3.1.1: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/.well-known/openapi.json
- API catalog: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent skill: https://kiln.timcf.workers.dev/agent-skills/kiln-cad-builds/SKILL.md

## MCP surface
20 tools: list_projects, create_project, update_project, get_project,
put_source, get_source, list_source_history, set_params, get_params, put_doc,
get_doc, run_build, retry_build, cancel_build, get_build, list_builds,
list_artifacts, get_artifact_url, verify_target, measure.

Public read tools require no credentials. Write and compute tools require a
validated Access identity or the transition API key. Tool calls return
structured {ok,data} or {ok,error} envelopes, stable error fields, behavior
annotations, and text equivalents. get_artifact_url also returns a resource
link. Access Managed OAuth is the preferred interactive authentication flow;
authorization is checked on every protected tools/call.

Five public resource templates:
- kiln://projects/{slug}
- kiln://projects/{slug}/sources/{+path}
- kiln://projects/{slug}/documents/{kind}
- kiln://projects/{slug}/builds/{build_id}
- kiln://projects/{slug}/builds/{build_id}/artifacts/{+path}

One prompt: cad-discipline.

run_build is asynchronous. It pins every current source path/version/SHA-256,
exact parameters, entry, timeout, and printer_profile {x,y,z}, then returns the
canonical build_id. Poll get_build about every 15 seconds until verified,
failed, or cancelled. Use idempotency_key for uncertain queue delivery.
cancel_build affects active builds; retry_build creates a new build from exact
terminal-build inputs.

## REST highlights
- GET /api/health and GET /api/engine/healthz are public health endpoints.
- GET /api/projects and all project/source/history/params/docs/build/artifact
  reads are public.
- GET /api/session returns sanitized authentication and permission state.
- POST/PATCH/PUT project data requires Access or the transition API key.
- POST /api/projects/{slug}/builds queues compute with printer_profile x/y/z.
- POST /api/projects/{slug}/builds/{id}/cancel cancels active work.
- POST /api/projects/{slug}/builds/{id}/retry queues exact pinned inputs.
- POST /api/projects/{slug}/builds/{id}/verify compares one STL extent and is
  protected compute.
- GET /api/projects/{slug}/builds/{id}/artifacts lists exact artifact SHA-256
  metadata and supports opaque cursor pagination.
- The raw engine build, measure, render, and artifact routes are not public.

Current build archives contain exact artifact SHA-256 metadata and
_kiln/archive-manifest.json. Legacy archives remain readable but explicitly do
not claim provenance or digest verification. A verified status means geometry
preflight and archive integrity passed, not that a physical outcome is assured.

## Discovery and content
- /server.json is MCP Registry metadata.
- /.well-known/mcp.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json, and
  /.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json are deprecated compatibility aliases; no
  ratified Server Card protocol is claimed.
- /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json is a non-standard compatibility index.
- Send Accept: text/markdown to / or /projects/{slug} for negotiated Markdown.
- /sitemap.xml lists the homepage and public project pages.
